notes: The corner you are heading into shows the gear to take it in - and one stray sample can no longer decide that gear (Winton's Turn 3 was being called "first gear"). A lap now has a talking budget, so SMART stops arriving in bursts, and the corner costing you most always gets through. It says where your time goes at a circuit before the first lap, from your own past sessions. A corner where something actually happened is drawn as not scored, not as bad technique.
